cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You've locked the shop. You can stop doing the cheerful voice for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'm off the clock. What did that empty till do to you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't owe me a second performance. Can we lock the stockroom and let you be upset out here?

mechanism: A copies a closing-shop procedure without understanding it and confidently invites B to drop professional cheerfulness.
confusable: D108 lowers B guard; D107 would test support through A increasing disclosure.
comparison: Shopkeeper after bad day versus lonely companion at home.
seedUse: Keep B stockroom admission becoming permission to be upset openly.
